# Everything about the new event: Healthy and Safe / Safe and Sound

![](/uploads/ajaxGallery_168_nukaknights-post-event-safe-and-sound.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

The new “Healthy and Safe” event will be introduced with the Patch 44 update on June 20, 2023. It is a **public event**, so it rotates with the other public events and starts on the hour, at 8 p.m. and 40 p.m. It's all about the Blue Ridge Caravan Company. The former location "Mittelberghütten" was renamed "**Mittelbergstation**" and has become a stopover for the Brahmin caravans of the **Blue Ridge Caravan Company**. Our task is now to fend off the attacking creatures so that the Mittelberg station is safe again. At the end of the event, the new cryptid "**Blue Devil**" and boss spawns.

*Bethesda writes:*

Blue Ridge has developed the Midmountain Lodges into the newest and greatest Brahmin station, but can't keep the local creatures under control. The loudspeaker system designed to scare away the beasts and protect the Brahmin was damaged. To take back the station and create a safe haven for the company's own Brahmin, they need your help! Eliminate the creatures and defend the deterrent to reap a hefty reward from the Blue Ridge Caravan for your assistance.

## Location: Mittelbergstation

The location "Mittelberghütten" was converted into "Mittelbergstation" and now serves as a station for the Brahmin of the Blue Ridge Caravan Company. As before, Mittelbergstation is located in the “Savage Divide” area. There is now a signaling system in the middle and the roofs of the huts are connected to each other with suspension bridges. You can also find new NPCS and traders here. The new side quest “Costa’s Affairs” also leads you here.

![Mittelbergstation](/uploads/nukaknights-event-safe-and-sound-fallout76-22.04.2023-00-55-30.png) 

![Mittelbergstation overview](/uploads/nukaknights-event-safe-and-sound-fallout76-22.04.2023-00-57-40.png) 

![Mittelbergstation](/uploads/nukaknights-event-safe-and-sound-fallout76-22.04.2023-01-09-52.png) 

## Process

To actually start the event you have a few minutes to speak to Vera. **Vera Thornberg** is an employee of the Blue Ridge Caravan Company and also has a shop at the Mittelberg station. 

![Event: Healthy and safe starting point with Vera Thornberg](/uploads/nukaknights-event-safe-and-sound-fallout76-22.04.2023-01-01-06.png) 

![Event: Healthy and Safe Defense of the Defense Generator](/uploads/nukaknights-event-safe-and-sound-fallout76-22.04.2023-01-03-36.png) 

Now it's your job to fend off the attackers in several **waves**. The attackers come from all sides and attack you and the generator.

- 1. Hut "General Store": Three wolves attack
- 2. Hut "The Boozin Brahmin": Honey Beast attacks
- 2. Hut "The Boozin Brahmin": Swarms of bees attack
- 3. Hut "Sleepstop": Two Yao Guai attack
- Rad Scorpions attack from the ground

After these waves, the **circuits** in the huts are now broken and need to be repaired. There are 6 circuits in and on the huts that you now have to repair.

![Event: Healthy and Safe Circuit Repair](/uploads/nukaknights-event-safe-and-sound-circuit.jpg) 

The next step is to protect the loudspeaker tower from the attackers. After 3 waves of attackers that the players have successfully fought, the final phase begins.

**Final Phase: Blue Devil Spawn**

In the final phase, the goal is to either kill the Blue Devil Cryptid or defend the generator. If the timer expires before the Blue Devil is defeated, or the generator is broken, the event will fail.

The **Blue Devil** is one of the two new cryptids coming to the game in Patch 44. He is a werewolf and moves like a T
